PhoneSoc.use: 16:9 phone with a centred SoC chip; inside it a blue NPU, outside it an orange LPDDR memory block linked by a thin line. Starts as the whole phone and zooms into the SoC and NPU. Use to show where the NPU sits on the chip and how it reaches memory.

props.zoom: 0..1, zooms from the whole phone into the SoC and NPU

PhoneSoc.beats: reveal: zoom continues into the SoC

MatrixArray.use: 16:9 matrix compute view. prefill: two 8x8 blue matrices multiply into a third, with a COMPUTE tag (compute-bound, cells sweep in a wave). decode: a column vector times a wide orange weight block, with green data packets streaming in from MEMORY (memory-bound). Use prefill for the compute stage and decode for the token-by-token memory stage.

ModelShrink.use: 16:9 green 7B model block made of parameter tiles, labelled 7B with its size, inside a fixed orange memory bar. Lower precision makes the block physically shorter, so it fits the memory space. Use to show quantisation (FP16 to INT8 to INT4) shrinking the model.

props.bits: 16 | 8 | 4, model block shrinks to that precision (16 = FP16 14 GB, 8 = INT8 7 GB, 4 = INT4 3.5 GB)

ModelShrink.beats: reveal: block eases to the bits value over 0.6 s
